test_title: PYST 3: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
Following Pie chart presents monthly expenditure by Sushma and Preeti in different heads. Sushma and Preeti make equal expenditure every month.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2616ef11e63b62911c3892049fec21be8c56a78093b7d7fbf5b6ea9795b2607.png] 

 

What is the difference between the expenditure (in Rs.) done on Food by Sushma and Preeti?
solution:
**Solution:**

Sushma Expenditure = 6000

Total expenditure of Sushma = 6000 + 7200 + 2500 + 7500 + 1800 + 5000

⇒ 30000

According to the question, 

Preeti expenditure in food = 15%

⇒ 30000 × 15/100

⇒ 4500

**∴ The difference between the expenditure (in Rs.) done on Food by Sushma and Preeti is 6000 - 4500 = 1500.**
